title: Keep Main candidate artwork binary through its existing decoded picture owner
scope: Main opts both initial Start/restore flight-picture acquisition and Next/Retry attempt preparation into binary display preparation. Default preview, creator and compile-edition serialization remains unchanged.
One shared streaming/digest/MIME/header/dimension/deadline implementation produces either privately branded serialized media or immutable Blob media.

The candidate picture owner creates and retains one Blob URL through decode and final display use; release clears the image and revokes once. Abort/decode failures revoke promptly; the shared decoder disposes late images.
No changed mission URL, asset identity, checkpoint, save or replay format; no new runtime module, asset path, worker or scheduler.
Existing Main test image codecs use native image Blob URLs even with audioHarness. One data-URL-only Journey fixture now uses the existing exact-byte PNGImage; no assertions or deadlines are relaxed.
Fixture teardown first requests runtime pagehide disposal, then finally revokes any remaining registry references through their original image/audio owner, including unadopted URLs.

controls: PNG/JPEG/WebP exact binary bytes and MIME; no FileReader/btoa; private brand and serialized-preview exclusion
Blob URL lives through held complete decode and single display transfer; one final release

Actual nested host teardown leaves an unadopted image URL and audio URL, then verifies native deregistration and exactly one audio revocation. Fixture finally cleanup also runs if pagehide rejects.
